title: Andalusian Paella with Mushroom and Chestnut
description: A vegetarian paella recipe inspired by the flavors of Andalusia, featuring sautéed mushrooms and chestnuts.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat.
Add the garlic and sauté for 1 minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and sauté until they release their liquid and start to brown.
Add the chestnuts, diced tomato, and vegetable broth.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes.
Add the Andalusian paella rice and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
Remove from heat and let rest for 5 minutes before serving.
